h: Trump reportedly offers $1 million rewards for tips on voter fraud in US elections
p: US President Donald Trump has reportedly said the government will pay $1 million for information that leads to proof of voter fraud. The announcement is said to have come as the American political season heats up.
more: Critics are expected to question how such rewards would be verified and funded.
No official guidance on how to claim the reward has been reported yet.
